## What changes for users?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include a small before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and the environments tested. Link CI results when available. State what you could not test.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the scope described above.
- [ ] Beginner instructions and profile membership are accurate, if affected.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or this is a documentation-only change with links and commands checked.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, or personal configuration are included.
- [ ] Changes to installed tools or user settings are explained.
